parameters.query:
SELECT l.*, lc.day_number, lc.last_sms_sent 
FROM leads l 
JOIN lead_campaigns lc ON l.id = lc.lead_id 
WHERE lc.campaign_type = 'drip' 
AND lc.status = 'active' 
AND lc.sms_enabled = true 
AND (lc.last_sms_sent IS NULL OR lc.last_sms_sent < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day') 
AND lc.day_number <= 30 
ORDER BY lc.priority DESC, l.lead_score DESC 
LIMIT 100
UPDATE lead_campaigns SET last_sms_sent = NOW(), sms_count = sms_count + 1, day_number = day_number + 1 WHERE lead_id = $1 RETURNING *
